payload.reason: The evidence indicates that pruning was performed on the data used to train the KDG model, which significantly affected its performance.

claims.text: The KDG model's performance depends on a certain pruning of the data used to train it, which was crucial for achieving higher accuracy.
Disabling the pruning step resulted in a drop in accuracy from 43.3% to 36.3%, indicating the importance of this pruning process.
Pruning out spurious logical forms before training is an important factor in the performance improvement of the KDG model.
